correctness.rationale: For each p^a, the Ramanujan prime-power identity splits the circulant into p^{a-1} copies of p^{a-1}(pI-J). Exact row/column operations and determinantal divisors give Smith factors 1,p^(p-2),0 for pI-J, with p=2 handled. Chinese-remainder permutation tensor products preserve integrally unimodular equivalences; independently sorting prime valuations across the phi(n) nonzero diagonal entries produces the stated divisibility-ordered factors, with n=1 and n=2 boundaries. The determinant product, exponent, congruence kernel and cyclicity criteria follow from those invariant factors. Independently constructed Ramanujan integer matrices and computed exact SymPy Smith forms for every 1<=n<=15; all factors matched. This finite test is not the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Finite checks are only corroboration; proof relies on stated unrestricted symbolic/collapsing argument.
